name: Separate the changes needed together from a change that suffices on its own

uses.action: Keep the four punches fixed and stamp all four wheel and crew arrangements. Only the joint change raises the output on this strip.

name: Compare a worker’s deliberate invention with a rule governing whose work counts

uses.action: Bind the same dates by wheel and rota, try both people in the lead, and commit a printed edition grounded in a worked settlement or mill run.

name: Set a missed possibility and an open future in different verb forms

uses.action: Print a counterfactual edition using had stayed and could have cut, then a prospective edition using comes tomorrow and can feed. Either can go to the three workers.

name: Test a numerical estimate alongside the institutional history of the shift

uses.action: Bind the four shifts by wheel and by the guild’s change to the rota. Try the two estimates against an off-rota reconstruction. The historical averages fit both groupings and cannot decide between them.
